content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in the early part of the 30-day horizon, especially after recent spikes; adjust downward bias for first 5–7 days.
- Overestimates after sharp price spikes (e.g., 35.63→36.62) — apply lag correction: reduce forecast by 10–15% for 3–5 days post-spike.
- Mean reversion bias: model overreacts to short-term volatility; dampen forecast volatility by smoothing 3–5 day moving average of true values.
- Sentiment history is neutral (all 0.00) — no sentiment-driven correction needed; rely on price momentum and mean reversion.
- Horizon-specific error: 30-day forecasts often overshoot mid-term highs; cap forecast at 1.5x recent 14-day high for 10–15 days post-spike.
- If true outcome shows sudden drop after spike, model fails to adjust — add 2–3 day lag correction to prevent premature recovery.
